---
description: Layout and conventions for device-class libraries such as DenoXfsIdc
applyTo: "src/DenoXfsIdc/**"
---
# Device-class libraries

`DenoXfsIdc` is the template; new classes (CDM, PIN, PTR, ...) follow it.

- Project references `DenoXfsCore`; root namespace `DenoXfs.{Class}`.
- `Api/Xfs{Class}*.cs`: marshalled structs for the class; `Idc.cs`-style entry file for the class API.
- `Models/Enums`, `Models/Structs`: managed models; `Constants/`: `WFS_{CLASS}_*` constants.
- `Abstractions/`, `Extensions/`: interfaces and DI registration for the class.
- Most of this is generated by `tools/HtmlToXfs2` (constants, enums, structs); change the generator or its inputs instead of hand-editing generated files.

New device library: create csproj referencing Core, run the generator for the class, add a DI extension, add the project to `DenoXfs.slnx`.
